notes.title: The conclusion of Steams Next Fest!
notes.content:
[h1]The demo will still be available until July 2nd[/h1]

I want to thank everyone who tried out the demo for OutRune, especially those who left comments in the community hub and other platforms. Every piece of feedback will be studied and used to inform what things need the most attention during the next stage of development.

Some stand-out issues that need addressing:

- Item and drop balancing
- Stat balancing
- Bringing to light the lore and story of the game
- Making the Aramon Guard loop more interesting
- Improving the visibility and comprehensiveness of the tutorial
- More hints on screen 
- Power-up effects visibility before picking up
- Physical effect that some stats have on the projectiles (making accuracy not affect range, for example)
- Enemy attack telegraphing 
- General audio consistency

And much more that came up after all the excellent constructive feedback from you guys. 

[h1]What happens next?[/h1]

So there will be one more week where the demo will be available to play. This is for those who may not have had time to give it a go during the festival. It will be de-listed after this so I can put all my efforts into developing the game further to reach my target for the early access release. This may include some pretty big changes, so leaving the demo up in its current state may mislead players, and it also allows me to spend my time on the full game rather than maintaining the demo. As a solo developer, time is something in very short supply!

You can still join the discord to join me on this journey, and if you are interested in giving your opinion as the game develops, this is a perfect place to do so:

[url=https://discord.gg/xTtpWgSX3Y]OutRune Discord Server[/url]

So I will be having a much-needed rest for a few days and then working on the next stage of development.

Thanks again, and I hope to see you on the Discord server!

notes.title: OutRune Demo Alpha 0.2.8 - Update
notes.content:
Apologies for the larger update. The reason for this is due to a full lighting build and PSO cache to avoid those retched shader stutters, which is why the files were flagged as new and changed, resulting in a re-download for you guys. I will try and do these kinds of updates sparingly to avoid longer update times. 

[h1]Updates in 0.2.8[/h1]

-Added camera zoom on start to expose tutorial for new players
-Fixed rune-machine pop-up appearing then disappearing when exiting the deposit zone when the -machine has been used
-slightly increased flyer mech damage radius
-increased Ash base speed slightly
-Fixed dash tutorial info not changing to controller-specific text
-Generated full PSO cache for tutorial and standard run
-Added wooden beams to hide the ugly floor cut-off when walls go transparent
-Added some pipes to starting room to make the zoom-out less empty
-Full production light build
-Increased max roughness for the world (shinier pipes where before some pipes looked dull)
-Added floor progress pop-up back to the start of the run
-Changed lighting channel for the player spotlight to avoid unwanted light interactions when up close to walls -and doors etc
-Added bomb droppers to certain rooms

As always, you can join the discord if you'd like to join me on this journey and have your say :)

https://discord.gg/xTtpWgSX3Y

notes.title: Pre Next Fest update!
notes.content:
Another whirlwind weekend! 

[h1]Tutorial:[/h1]

After a few days of catching my breath, I decided at the last minute that new players may need a tutorial more than I had thought. So I spent the weekend drafting one up. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43477691/c21bd0758c6d3108adc435bfbf8fa2f0e24743dd.jpg[/img]
Apples?

I use the word draft because it's a little rough around the edges and could use some improvement, but the essential parts are there, hopefully bringing new players up to speed with how the game works. Most seasoned gamers will not need the tutorial, but it's short, so it might be fun to do regardless. It would also greatly help if you could join the Discord and let me know of any feedback/concerns, or bugs you may have. You can find the discord server here: 

https://discord.gg/xTtpWgSX3Y

[h3]Important note - I did not have time to do a full PSO cache, so stutters MAY be present during your first play-through of the tutorial (It's only the first time when you first load a particle effect, for example). This will be addressed as soon as possible.[/h3]

[h1]Responding to community feedback:[/h1]

After receiving frustration with the aiming indicator, I realised that the adjustment I planned for it needed to be put at the top of my priorities as it did cause controller players to be hindered compared to PC players, so I improved the aiming indicator:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43477691/56812ec3c7c4bc92f7b40267b0bd25ecd292bf33.jpg[/img]

You can turn the indicator off in the settings (if you want a more immersive but WAY more challenging experience):

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43477691/2d3b579da45590aae047dc36e3987f3f41b962d2.jpg[/img]

I was also thinking about adding a feature in the future that allowed players to customise the aiming indicator, similar to how some FPS games enable players to change the reticle on specific scopes. If this is something you would like, then please let me know!

[h2]Have fun at the festival![/h2]

Welcome aboard to anyone joining this adventure during Steam Next Fest! If you're interested in joining the OutRune community, feel free to check out the Discord server. As the sole developer, I greatly appreciate constructive feedback from community members who share my passion for the game's success. Thank you to everyone who has already joined and those who will be a part of this community.

[h2]A small reminder that the demo will be available until the 2nd of July, a week after the conclusion of Next Fest[/h2]
